newsitem.title: JAPAN: Typhoon hits Idemitsu berth, operations unaffected.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon hits Idemitsu berth, operations unaffected.

text.p: Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd said on Wednesday that a berth at its Chiba refinery, east of Tokyo, was damaged by Typhoon Violet, but plant operations had not been affected as vessels were moved other berths.
Part of the berth, mainly used to receive crude carriers from China and naphtha vessels, was damaged on Sunday due to strong waves caused by the typhoon, an Idemitsu spokesman said.
He said the firm still did not know when it could bring the troubled berth back to use as it was still checking the extent of the damage.
Chiba refinery has a crude processing capacity of 250,000 barrels per day and has four berths, including the damaged one, to receive tankers.
